unstuck_said.text: Filed issue getwaysafe/waysafe#1: "A Nano (XNO) rail gives the evidence layer a self-verifying block — no per-transfer cost". Framed in their own terms — Waysafe is the authorization/evidence layer for agent spending across every rail (ALLOW|DENY|STEP_UP, evidence makes the decision checkable). A Nano block IS that evidence, feeless, re-derivable by any node. Proposed Nano as a rail the authorize() gate covers with the block hash as the authorization evidence record. No machine signature.
